verdict.rationale: Delegated-access rules are a fair question for a state business-filing registry, but the evidence pack has no published third-party authorization forms, delegate role definitions, or statement of which signatures must stay personal. The 'Mass change registered agent' PDF and the prepaid account application are adjacent registry features. They do not define what a third party may do on a filer's behalf, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
